lead.headline: Monangai is in a boot and both Vikings receivers are questionable; McLaurin practised and Likely is cleared
lead.deck: Friday's reports are in. Nothing to do today; three names to read on Sunday's inactive lists.
lead.body: Start with the bad news about your own players. Kyle Monangai is out for Green Bay and it is worse than a missed game: Ben Johnson says the toe 'is a bigger deal than we initially anticipated', and he is in a walking boot, seeing a specialist, week-to-week. He was on your bench at 0.0. Justin Jefferson was limited for a third day and is questionable, and so is Jordan Addison, his fallback; Kevin O'Connell will 'make that determination tomorrow', with a bye next week to tempt him. Alvin Kamara is questionable too. Now the better news. Isaiah Likely practised in full and carries no designation, which ends four days of worry about a tight-end slot with nobody behind it. Terry McLaurin practised for the first time since 2 Oct, limited, and Dan Quinn said he 'looked really good'; Stefon Diggs is ruled out and Jayden Daniels starts. ESPN trimmed McLaurin to 12.8, which makes him a coin flip with Ollie Gordon for your flex, and coin flips go to the projection: he goes in if he is active. Elsewhere, Rico Dowdle is questionable behind your Jaylen Warren, and the Jets ruled out Adonai Mitchell and Breece Hall around Garrett Wilson. Your opponent, Los Gigantes de Teca, lead 31.5 to nothing on Bucky Irving and moved Ja'Marr Chase, questionable in the concussion protocol, to their bench this morning. Among leaguemates, Bok-aneers and Footballers took the Bengals' and Jaguars' defences. Nothing needs doing today. On Sunday at 09:30 read the inactive lists for McLaurin, Jefferson and Addison.
